But how did a 3-year-old manage to survive alone in the wilderness for two days? The mysterious situation quickly led to disturbing theories online, with some people believing something strange could have been hiding in the woods. Add salt, paprika, ground coriander, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated. 5. Arrange the marinated chicken pieces on top of the potatoes. 6. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Bake for 50–60 minutes, until the chicken is fully cooked, golden brown, and the potatoes are tender.
